model.note: Set OPENAI_MODEL to a provider version-pinned identifier before freezing a live baseline.

stale_flag_rate.requirement: gold.stale_presented_as_new plus a verification output field/contract that records a stale flag; VerifiedTrend has neither

precision_at_3.requirement: gold labels must be event-level and map each expected event to its signals; CurriculumAgent exposes one selected match, not its top-3 candidates

recall.requirement: gold labels must be event-level and map each expected event to its signals plus gold.acceptable_citations

correct_abstention_rate.requirement: gold labels must be event-level and map each expected event to its signals plus gold.no_match_expected

spearman_rank_correlation.requirement: gold labels must be event-level and map each expected event to its signals plus gold.rank

maturity_mae.requirement: gold labels must be event-level and map each expected event to its signals plus gold.maturity (1–5)

relevance_mae.requirement: gold labels must be event-level and map each expected event to its signals plus gold.relevance (1–5)

exact_tier_accuracy.requirement: gold labels must be event-level and map each expected event to its signals plus gold.action_tier

off_by_one_tier_accuracy.requirement: gold labels must be event-level and map each expected event to its signals plus gold.action_tier and an agreed ordered-tier policy

over_recommendation_rate.requirement: gold labels must be event-level and map each expected event to its signals plus gold.action_tier and an agreed ordered-tier policy
